scope.phase: Round18 Phase II P7 offline route working-set precheck

source.identity: Round9 v80 SGLang Layerwise host-only diagnostic route tape
source.workload: two 32-token Prefill chunks; not W1/W2/W4 Decode

data_quality.assessment: Internally complete for the recorded 64-token historical request, but semantically ineligible as a fresh Round18 Native W1/W2/W4 trace.

model.important_correction: The earlier R18_ROUTE_WORKING_SET_HISTORICAL_PRECHECK.json divided transfer bytes by 32. This file uses the full 64-token request denominator.

per_32_token_layer_invocation_union.interpretation: A Native Prefill invocation over the full 32-token chunk cannot generally execute from Q32/Q64 without staging or splitting; the token-serial simulations below are sensitivity analyses, not proof of graph-compatible Native Prefill.

bandwidth_sensitivity.basis: Belady with same-trace frequency warm start; transfer-only lower-bound sensitivity, excluding format, publish, synchronization and graph-break costs

q32_vllm_runtime_reference.note: This includes the historical vLLM-KT runtime and a large KV allocation; it is not a fresh Round18 expert-pool capacity measurement.

assessment.Q32: Existing nominal payload identity only; pool runtime still requires a fixed-slot component proof.
assessment.Q64: Potentially capacity-testable only after fresh headroom and KV/graph-pool sizing; adds 14.0625 GiB payload over Q32.
assessment.Q96: Not capacity-qualified; 42.1875 GiB expert payload leaves only 13.3125 GiB under the whole-card cap for all dense/shared weights, state, KV and workspace.
assessment.Q128: Nominal expert payload alone is 56.25 GiB and exceeds the 55.5 GiB whole-card cap; ineligible under the frozen contract.

methodology.access_grain: One token-layer Top-10 event; experts within an event are protected from eviction while that event is processed
methodology.static_frequency: Per-layer Top-Q derived from the same trace. Misses are counted as required loads but the fixed resident set is not mutated; this implicitly needs scratch or reload behavior and is a predictor, not an exact Q-slot runtime.
methodology.lru: Event-grain deterministic LRU, reported cold and same-trace-frequency warm-start.
methodology.belady: Offline farthest-next-use eviction, reported cold and same-trace-frequency warm-start. Warm-start uses future information twice and is an optimistic ceiling, not a deployable policy result.
methodology.transfer: miss_loads multiplied by 9,830,400 BF16 payload bytes per expert; excludes padding, metadata, online format conversion and publish overhead.

disposition.economic_signal: Q32 and Q64 remain transfer-heavy even under optimistic same-trace oracles. Q96/Q128 reduce misses but are not capacity-qualified, and Q128 is impossible under the frozen whole-card cap.
disposition.native_prefill_signal: Q32 and Q64 cannot hold any observed 32-token layer working set in one invocation. Preserving an unsplit Native Prefill kernel would require a much larger pool or a different device-side streaming primitive.
required_next_evidence: Fresh Round18 Native W1/W2/W4 route traces, separated into Prefill and Decode
A DEV/HOLDOUT split for frequency plans; no same-trace warm-start promotion claims
Fresh HBM headroom and fixed-slot write/publish component cost
Graph-safe residency probe showing no per-token Host route readback
